title: Bot self-kill safety gate — escape-route pre-check before bomb placement (cluster-rooms / chokepoint maps)
intent: On complex maps (cluster-rooms, chokepoint) bots frequently kill themselves by placing bombs in corridors and tight rooms where ALL passable neighbours fall within the bomb's own blast radius. The bot then has zero safe exit cells (safeNeighbours = []) and picks a random dangerous cell — walking straight into its own explosion. The fix is a lightweight pre-check inside decideBotShouldDropBomb: simulate the hypothetical bomb blast on the current cell and refuse to place if zero safe neighbours remain after that simulation. This is a single-function change of ~15 LOC, no architecture change. Aggression on open cells is unchanged — the gate only fires in the specific case where the bot would trap itself.
rationale: User feedback 2026-06-04: bots self-destruct rapidly on cluster-rooms. Root cause identified by design-terminal reading bot-ai-perception.ts + bot-ai-decision.ts: buildBotDangerMap already marks own-bomb blast cells as danger AFTER placement, but decideBotShouldDropBomb only checks `danger.has(currentCell)` from EXISTING bombs — it does not simulate the prospective bomb. On maps with 1–2 passable exits, prospective blast covers them all. The failure mode is reproducible without A* (A* was added in S282 for navigation, not bomb safety) and predates it. GDP-2026-06-02-002 (full A* safety) is the long-term fix; this story ships the targeted gate before that sprint so the game is playable now.
acceptanceHints: PHASE 1 — DIAGNOSTIC RECORDING (before writing code)
1a. Start the dev server (`npm run dev`). Load cluster-rooms scene with 3 bots, 0 humans.
Use the freecam probe or spectator mode so the match runs unsupervised for 60 seconds.
1b. Capture evidence of the failure mode BEFORE fixing it:
- `curl http://localhost:5173/__agf/console-log` — grab the full console log.
- `curl http://localhost:5173/__agf/recording` — grab the recording.
Specifically look for sequences where a bot places a bomb then immediately dies within
bomb.range × 2 ticks (no movement away). These are the self-kills.
1c. Add a temporary diagnostic log in `pickBotDirection` (bot-ai-decision.ts, line ~63):
When `safeNeighbours.length === 0` and `inDanger === false` (bot just trapped itself),
log: `[bot-self-trap] gx={pos.gx} gz={pos.gz} safeNeighbours=0 totalNeighbours={neighbours.length}`.
Run another 60-second bot match and capture console-log. Count occurrences.
This confirms the hypothesis before touching the placement logic.
PHASE 2 — THE FIX (~15 LOC in bot-ai-decision.ts)
2a. Add helper function `hasSafeExitAfterBomb` in bot-ai-helpers.ts (or inline in bot-ai-decision.ts):
function hasSafeExitAfterBomb(
pos: { gx: number; gz: number },
bombRange: number,
existingDanger: ReadonlySet<string>,
occupancy: BotOccupancyQuery
): boolean {
// Simulate own bomb blast from pos.
const simDanger = new Set(existingDanger);
simDanger.add(cellKey(pos.gx, pos.gz)); // bomb cell itself
for (const dir of DIRECTIONS_4) {
for (let step = 1; step <= bombRange; step++) {
const gx = pos.gx + dir.dx * step;
const gz = pos.gz + dir.dz * step;
if (occupancy.blocked(gx, gz, 'blast')) break;
simDanger.add(cellKey(gx, gz));
if (occupancy.blocked(gx, gz, 'movement')) break; // soft block — shields further
// Check if at least one passable neighbour is outside simulated danger.
for (const dir of DIRECTIONS_4) {
const gx = pos.gx + dir.dx;
const gz = pos.gz + dir.dz;
if (occupancy.blocked(gx, gz, 'movement')) continue;
if (!simDanger.has(cellKey(gx, gz))) return true;
return false;
2b. Call it inside `decideBotShouldDropBomb` (bot-ai-decision.ts), just BEFORE the aggression roll
and AFTER the existing `danger.has(currentCell)` gate. Add as a universal pre-check:
const range = Math.max(1, Math.floor(stats.range ?? 2));
if (!hasSafeExitAfterBomb(pos, range, danger, deps.occupancy)) return false;
This must run before ALL placement branches (remote-detonate, shield, pierce, aggression).
Even a tactical remote-detonate should refuse if it would trap the bot.
2c. Remove the temporary diagnostic log added in Phase 1 before committing.
PHASE 3 — VERIFICATION
3a. Run another 60-second bot-only match on cluster-rooms. Capture console-log.
The `[bot-self-trap]` diagnostic line should no longer appear (confirms the gate fires).
Verify that all 3 bots survive significantly longer — death-count per 60s should drop.
3b. Run a 60-second bot-only match on the OPEN arena (standard flat map, no narrow corridors).
Bomb placement frequency per bot per minute should be comparable to before the fix (±20%).
If bomb rate drops by more than 20% on the open map, the gate is too aggressive — review
the range calculation (check that `stats.range` is read correctly).
3c. Run a mixed match (1 human + 2 bots) on cluster-rooms. Confirm bots still place bombs
when they have a clear escape route — they should not be purely passive.
DESIGN CONSTRAINTS
DO NOT change bot aggression weights, personality weights, or timing.
DO NOT add memory of past self-kills, multi-step lookahead (>1 step), or path simulation.
The gate is PURELY about the IMMEDIATE next tick's escape options — one-step lookahead only.
If all 4 neighbours are blocked by walls (bot is walled in), hasSafeExitAfterBomb returns false
— this is correct and desirable: a walled-in bot should not bomb at all.
The fix must NOT affect bot behaviour toward human players on open maps — aggression on
cells with at least one safe exit is completely unchanged.
TESTS
Unit tests for hasSafeExitAfterBomb:
Open cell (4 passable neighbours, no walls): returns true (bomb doesn't cover all exits at range=2).
Corridor trap (bot at centre, walls N/S, passable E/W, range=2): simulated blast covers E+W → returns false.
Corner with exit: bot at corner, walls N+W, passable S+E, range=1 → blast covers S+E → returns false.
Corner with exit at range=1: bot at corner, walls N+W, passable S (range=1 blast → S covered), passable E (not in blast) → returns true.
Soft block shields: bot in corridor, soft block to the East at step=1 (movement-blocked, not blast-blocked) → blast stops at soft block → E neighbour NOT in simDanger → returns true.
